Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather just keep it to the accident, if that's alright.
Q: That's fine. We'll keep it brief. Can you tell me where you were when the collision happened?
A: I was in Houston, on one of the main freeways, heading toward the downtown exit. Traffic was moving but not fast.
Q: What lane were you in, and what were you doing at the time?
A: I was in the middle lane. I wanted to move into the right lane because my exit was coming up, so I checked my
mirror and eased over.
Q: Did you signal before moving over?
A: I believe I did. I had the turn signal on for a few seconds before I started to move.
Q: What happened next?
A: As I was moving over, the car on my right sort of drifted into me. I felt a bump on the passenger side and my car
pulled a little toward the shoulder. The otehr driver kept going for a second before they stopped.
Q: Were you able to see the other vehicle's lane position before you moved?
A: Not completely. It was in my blind spot for a moment, and I didn't see it until I was already partway over.
Q: Did you or the other driver exchange information at the scene?
A: Yes, we swapped insurance and contact details. The other driver seemed shaken but was polite.
Q: Have you been seen by a medical provider since the collision?
A: Yes. I've been having pain in my neck and lower back. It's mostly stiffness and soreness, and it gets worse when I
sit for long periods. I've been seeing a doctor and doing some physical therapy.
Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add?
A: Just that I'm trying to get back to normal and I'd appreciate a timely response on the claim.
Q: Thank you. That concludes the statement.
</page>

  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
